ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) surface area to 15% low-intensity (black) area located primarily at peripheral margins and localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white segments across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edge and tips. Distinct focal black spots (approx. 5-10 pixel diameter) are located near the median notch and scattered across the interior of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 45 pixels from the adjacent peak heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger, deeper jagged indentations (valleys) compared to the left lobe; peak-to-valley amplitude ranges from 2 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a neutral/straight trajectory at the mid-point, and terminating in sharp, upward-curved (convex) distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible roughly circular dark clusters on the white surface, most prominent near the central notch and at the distal end of the right lobe lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several vertical, dark, low-intensity linear marks on the left lobe and one prominent vertical linear disruption in the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical scarring and rake-like marks on the mid-surfaces of both lobes; visible irregular notches on the outer edge of the right tip suggesting minor tissue loss.
